tasks.title: Critical security remediation — close A-032 C-1 (audit chain fork) and verify C-2 (deletion-request authorisation) with adversarial execution
tasks.tool: Claude Code — critical security remediation and regression verification (disposable databases only; no deployment, no merge)
tasks.gate: FA-001 (staging build allowed; production NOT allowed)
tasks.notes: Baseline 8489353. C-1 was NOT fully closed by A-033: the matrix reproduced forks at baseline under REPEATABLE READ (stale snapshot after the lock) and under a 10x5 READ COMMITTED burst (identity default assigned seq before the lock, so seq order drifted from chain order; 2 of 50 burst rows mis-chained and verify falsely reported tampering). Fixed by append-only 0004: trigger assigns seq under the advisory lock; unique index on audit_events.prev_hash; USAGE on the sequence for the audit role; trigger remains SECURITY INVOKER. After fix: RC pair, RR pair (stale writer fails closed with unique_violation), SERIALIZABLE pair (serialization failure) and 10x5 burst all PASS, three repeats, 162 rows, 0 forks, 0 out-of-order rows, chain intact. C-2 already closed by A-033: 25/25 adversarial checks at baseline and after (cross-tenant, same-tenant cross-dispute, viewer, editor, direct-insert by owner/foreign user/service role, undo deadline server-computed from config and not client-writable, no re-scoping or state advance, undo refused after window, foreign vs nonexistent indistinguishable, every stored request authorised and scoped). request_deletion stays SECURITY DEFINER (justified: callers have no INSERT grant) with pinned search_path. Smoke 78/78 with 0001-0004 incl. 8 DUP_ and 13 STALE_; Vitest 162/162; tsc, eslint (0 errors), build, schema-lint clean. Registry ID pattern widened to allow the -R suffix.
